about: The welcome tutorial 'Welcome to Bon Adventure' (PWA restructure phase 6, 12 Nov 2026), played by scripts/learning/tutorial.gd once per profile. Guide: docs/guides/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_PART1.md#welcome-tutorial. Three acts; progress is saved per profile at the start of each act (the checkpoint), so every act begins with a 'place' step that puts the player and the cast where the act needs them. Since 14 Nov 2026 (user) the family bathroom door is open from the start (the friend there is behind one thing, the curtain) and BonBon waits in the living room by the teal chair, out from the wall, turned between that door and the suite. Since 13 Nov 2026 (user review) the player wakes in the guest suite (the south-east bedroom), only the suite, family bathroom, yellow bedroom (friend 2) and, at the end, front doors open (17 Nov 2026, user: the tutorial opens the suite and family bathroom doors itself; the player can open only the yellow bedroom door and, at the end, the front door), the market act keeps the player at the supermarket and its parking lot, and the statue step holds the player still with only the statue clickable. Cast roles: 'guide' and 'friend_1', 'friend_2' (the ids in 'guide' and 'friends'; one that is the player's avatar, the guide too since 17 Nov 2026, is replaced by the next house character in data/house_characters.json order). Every house character twin is hidden and none naps while the tutorial runs (17 Nov 2026), and act 1 starts with every home door shut (a replay). Spaces: 'home' = the home site's local coordinates (town units, as in scripts/buildings/home.gd), 'world' = world metres. 'look' is an [x, z] direction in that space; a cast member stands on the ground below 'at' unless 'ground' is false (then exactly at 'at': Sunny inside the bathtub). Lines are data/phrases.json ids; tutorial.* lines are spoken in the player's native language, 'learning': true lines in the language being learned. Step types: place, say, hint, wait, door, walk (an optional 'look' [x, z] turns the walker at the end), cutscene, shop (scripts/learning/tutorial_shop.gd), words (word cards on or off: 'on'; they are off from the start until this step, 13 Nov 2026; 'only': the one word key a click may open), lock (every door of 'space' except those named in 'open' says 'line' instead of opening; 'off': unlock), confine ('rects' [x0, z0, x1, z1] in 'space' the player stays inside, or 'hold': stay where you are; neither = free; 'line' flashes when held back). A place step's 'open_on' (a cast role) starts the close-up on that actor while the screen is dark, so the act opens on them talking (14 Nov 2026: BonBon, not the player in bed). Controls (16 Nov 2026, user): right after waking BonBon teaches turning the view and walking. A wait step 'for': 'view' ends when the player turned the view by hand ('turn' radians, a mouse or finger drag; or zoomed 'zoom' metres), 'for': 'move' when they walked 'distance' metres; meanwhile the matching control pulses (scripts/ui/tutorial_cue.gd; on a touch screen the joystick itself, touch_controls.gd highlight_stick(); 'cue' names another control than 'for'). Any say or hint step's 'touch_line' and a wait step's 'touch_where' replace 'line' / 'where' on a touch screen (hud.touch_mode; the first touch switches a showing hint). 'card_seconds': a word card opened during the tutorial closes by itself after this many seconds (user, 14 Nov 2026; interaction_controller.gd card_seconds). 'hide': nodes (paths under the town) hidden while the tutorial runs and shown again when it ends or is skipped (the mahjong table with its players, user 14 Nov 2026). A cast entry's 'camera' [x, y, z] fixes that actor's close-up camera spot (npc_presence.gd meta talk_camera_at). A wait step's 'where' is the phrase BonBon says when the player talks to her during it (where to go next); the shop trip has its own (tutorial_shop.gd where()). 'door': the supermarket doorway's invisible wall until the fruit is paid for (centre 'at', 'size' [across the doorway's depth, height, width], 'inward' [x, z] into the store; 14 Nov 2026). Shop items on the fruit table inside the supermarket's door (supermarket step tutorial_fruit). Tutorial script of 17 Nov 2026 (user): BonBon's lines are separate bubbles that move on by themselves (reading time, 0.6 s gap; a click, tap, E or Enter moves on) and hold the player; what to DO shows in the instruction strip (scripts/ui/instruction_strip.gd): a step 'strip' with its phrase ('line' / 'touch_line', or 'off'), or a wait step's 'strip' / 'touch_strip' shown while it waits. 'controls' steps allow 'look', 'move', 'use' (missing = true): first only E, then the view, then walking. 'find': the hiding friends in either order ('friends': 'role', 'hello' in the language being learned, 'hints' when asked, general to exact; a 'curtain' friend is near 'at' / 'radius' in 'space', BonBon says 'approach', the strip says 'strip' and the curtain opens with E (17 Nov 2026, user; it stays shut until the hunt); else 'radius' around the friend; each greeting waits for the player's 'reply' button, and the first introduces the EN button), 'objective' in the strip with the count, 'first' and 'all' said by BonBon. A lock step's 'say': true has the guide say 'line' in a bubble at a locked door ('remark_line' during the hunt) instead of flashing it; a locked door standing open cannot be used (17 Nov 2026, user: in the house only the hiding friend's door opens). 'pause': 'seconds' (the cast walking off). A cutscene's 'subtitle'; it can be skipped once the buildings are in and the later acts' views are drawn behind it. A say step's 'face': 'always' shows the close-up even when the speaker is far (BonBon after the friends are found, 17 Nov 2026). Review of 17 Nov 2026 (user): a say step's 'reply' is a button the line waits for (good_morning: 'Yes!'); BonBon's lines are in a close-up while she is near and standing; a 'view' wait counts zooming only with 'zoom'; a 'move' wait counts the way walked; a lock step's 'open_in' (building units) keeps their doors usable (the market act: the supermarket), the town acts lock every other door with 'not_right_place'; only doors and BonBon can be used during the tutorial; it starts at noon; the cast walks at the player's walking speed. A place step's 'picnic' ('at' [x, y, z], 'look') lays the blanket with the bought food (shop items). Shop: 'items' 1 apple and 2 bananas (1 dollar 50; user 17 Nov 2026, the cookies dropped), 'money' the denominations offered ($1 bills and quarters), 'hints' by group when asked (fruit; a 'cookie' group if the list has non-fruit items). Polish of 18 Nov 2026 (user): a say step's 'seconds' sets how long its bubble stays (instead of the reading time); 'remark_seconds' (phrase id -> seconds) shortens BonBon's short remarks; a door step may name its door ('name', e.g. the front door opening before 'lets_go_outside'); the dialogue box has no close button and the HUD clock and the Skip button (while an instruction strip shows) are hidden; back-to-back close-ups cut from face to face; in the market act the cast stands behind the player and does not move. Review of 20 Nov 2026 (user): shorter pauses after the look and walk lessons; BonBon says 'join me' in her close-up, pauses, then walks to the living room at 80% speed (a walk step's 'speed', a factor of the walking speed); 'let's go outside' and 'more to show' are one line; the dialogue box has no tail and the close-ups are closer and lower (tutorial.gd FACE_DISTANCE, FACE_ELEVATION); in the market act the friend's 'fruit for our picnic' leads straight to the clerk's welcome, and the first time the player comes near the fruit table's apples the camera eases in on them with the 'click the apple' line until something is picked (tutorial_shop.gd). Review of 21 Nov 2026 (user): the fruit costs $1.25 (price_cents 125: a $1 bill and a quarter); the cashier asks for it in her close-up with the shopping list hidden, and BonBon's 'meet outside' follows in hers; outside the store only two lines ('Everyone ready? Let's go to the park!' and Leo's 'Picnic time!'); a say step's 'face': 'always' on BonBon keeps the close-up chain (the camera pans from speaker to speaker: Sunny's 'what is that?' to BonBon, and every picnic line); a wait step 'for': 'card' waits until the word card is closed, then 'after' seconds (the statue's name comes 0.2 s after its card closes); the journal lines are one; the last line is 'The whole town is now yours to explore. Have fun!'. 'after': once the tutorial is played to the end (not skipped), the guide and friends stay seated round the picnic blanket at 'seats' (role -> 'at' [x, y, z], 'look' [x, z] in 'space'), and talking to one gives its next line of 'lines' (role -> phrase ids, in turn); The blanket is 6 x 4.75 m (2.5 times the first, tutorial.gd PICNIC_SIZE; user 21 Nov 2026), east of the statue, and the party sits on its edges, the east side left open for the player; they are not saved, so a reload or a replay does not show them again until the tutorial ends.
